objective_for_doctor:
Age: 61
Sex: F
Chief Complaint: pain

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I’ve been having pain in my mouth, forehead, right cheek, and my nose—it's burning and sharp (pain intensity about 3/10). I also have a fever, a cough, greenish/yellowish nasal discharge, and I’ve had a cold in the last 2 weeks. I’ve also had pneumonia before.

Thanks—one question at a time.  

**Do you have any facial swelling (especially around the eyes/cheeks) or severe pain that gets worse when you bend forward?**
Okay. **When you bend forward (or lean your head down), does the forehead/cheek/nose pain noticeably worsen?**
Understood. **Do you have any tooth pain or pain when you chew on the right side?**
Got it. **Is the fever high (e.g., ≥39°C / 102.2°F), and how many days has the fever been going on?**
I don’t know. I have a fever (either felt or measured with a thermometer).
Thanks. **How long have the current symptoms (burning facial pain + cough + green/yellow nasal discharge) been going on—days or weeks?**
I don’t know. I do know I had a cold in the last 2 weeks, and I have a cough and greenish or yellowish nasal discharge along with the burning/sharp pain.

**[ABSTAIN]** I don’t yet have enough discriminating details (timing/fever severity, whether facial pain worsens with bending, and any dental/tooth symptoms or facial swelling) to confidently narrow to one diagnosis.  

**[POSSIBLE]** Acute rhinosinusitis, Influenza, Pneumonia, Bronchitis, URTI
